messages.text: Ok change the default implementation to the new, faster description and make a PR.

I’ll put the faster Si–W wedge hierarchy on a dedicated branch, then check the maintained exporter, sensor IDs, material paths, and transport before opening a draft PR. I’ll verify the Spack runtime again for the native checks.

Opened [draft PR #129](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/129). It makes reusable wedge volumes the **LAYOUT-001 default** for the Si–W barrel and both endcaps. Standalone exports retain the legacy format for existing fixtures.

The ECAL-only DDG4 map build fell from **65.9 minutes to 23.0 seconds**. All **531,936 sensor IDs and transforms** and **65 material rays** agreed with stock. The full tracker-plus-ECAL scan found **zero overlaps at 10 nm**, and three electron transport smoke tests passed.

All hosted checks passed on the final commit after I corrected a broken documentation link.
